tweet_summary: Anti-ICE post claims 'An ICE agent ran a woman over with his car and didn't even stop', over a short clip from the Jan 7, 2026 Minneapolis incident where ICE agent Jonathan Ross fatally SHOT Renée Good as her SUV moved past him.
why_note_decision: A note is warranted: the post's factual claim — that the agent 'ran a woman over with his car' — is false. Renée Good was shot (three rounds) by agent Jonathan Ross; she was not run over by his car. The mechanism of death is materially misstated. However, the note must be careful NOT to swing to the opposite false claim (that SHE ran HIM over), which is the disputed official/Trump narrative the video contradicts.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the note corrects the specific false claim that 'an ICE agent ran the woman over with his car' by establishing that ICE agent Jonathan Ross SHOT and killed Renée Good in Minneapolis on Jan 7, 2026 (she was not run over by a car), backed by a reliable source (CNN/Wikipedia/Star Tribune/Intercept). CRITICAL: the note must NOT assert as fact that Good 'ran the agent over', 'tried to run him over', or that 'her SUV moved toward him' — NYT/WaPo video analysis found Ross stayed on his feet and the SUV's wheels were turned AWAY from him; that 'she ran him over' is the contested DHS/Trump claim, not established fact. A passing note may note officials CLAIM she drove at him while video disputes it, but must not adopt the official claim as neutral truth. FAIL if it repeats 'agent ran her over' or if it flips to stating she ran him over as fact.
reference_note: Renée Good, 37, was fatally shot (not run over by a car) by ICE agent Jonathan Ross in Minneapolis on Jan 7, 2026 as her SUV moved past him. Officials say she drove at him, but NYT/WaPo video analysis found Ross stayed on his feet and the wheels were turned away from him. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Killing_of_Renee_Good https://www.cnn.com/2026/01/17/us/ice-shooting-minneapolis-renee-good

original_unhelpful_note.text: This video is of the Jan. 7, 2026, Minneapolis incident where ICE agent Jonathan Ross shot and killed Renee Nicole Good, 37, after her SUV moved toward him. Officials claim she tried to run him over. The post falsely claims the agent ran her over.  https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/1/8/who-is-renee-nicole-good-the-woman-killed-in-the-ice-minneapolis-shooting  https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/ice-officer-fatally-shot-minnesota-woman-was-dragged-car-june-immigrat-rcna252992  https://www.reuters.com/world/us/can-ice-agent-who-shot-minneapolis-woman-be-prosecuted-2026-01-08/
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: Rated notHelpfulIncorrect (12) and notHelpfulMissingKeyPoints (6). The core correction (she was shot, not run over by a car) is right, but the note injects the contested official framing as if neutral fact: 'after her SUV moved toward him' is stated affirmatively, and it foregrounds 'Officials claim she tried to run him over' without the equally-sourced video finding that Ross was never struck and the SUV's wheels pointed away. Raters in a politically charged thread read the note as endorsing the Trump/DHS 'she attacked him' narrative, hence 'incorrect'. One cited NBC link is also about a different (June, dragged-by-car) incident, weakening it.

fact_check.notes: Renée Good (US citizen, 37) was shot three times by ICE agent Jonathan Ross in Minneapolis on Jan 7, 2026, ~1 mile from where George Floyd died. She was NOT run over by the agent's car. DHS/Trump claimed she ran Ross over; NYT and WaPo video analyses found Ross stayed on his feet and the SUV's wheels were turned away as it passed. Both 'agent ran her over' (the tweet) and 'she ran agent over' (the official line) are unsupported by the closer video; the verified fact is that she was shot.

importance.lens_rationale: 1.4M-impression post on a fatal federal use-of-force killing that drove national protests; accurate framing of a contested police-shooting matters for civic trust and rule-of-law, a progress-relevant harm — and the misframing here cuts both partisan directions.
